decisive_open_question: Can demand and reported cash survive normalized support inventory maintenance capital services leases taxes and dilution?
mechanism: Household price pressure changes product choice channel mix traffic and willingness to pay; value retailers may control the assortment and price architecture that captures that shift.
current_supported: Affordability signals are corroborated; the TJX Target and Walmart cohort shows relevant operating responses; and reported cash-after-property screens can be constructed on a common-period basis.
promotion_gate: Prove durable common-owner cash after inventory and supplier-finance normalization maintenance capital leases taxes attached-service costs support reversal and dilution.

theme: Scarce physical assets and contractual control

mechanism: A streaming contract can secure exposure to scarce long-lived production while the operator bears mine labor sustaining capital permitting and operating risk.
